name: Infinity Timetable 2.2.1
notes:
What's new in 2.2.1
- Master timetable: every subject code reads in full at Fit zoom; on phones it scrolls sideways
- ID cards: the code never covers details; long roles and names wrap instead of being cut
- ID cards: new Support staff list (bursar, secretary, drivers, guards)
- Staff cards show job title, department and subjects, and staff number
- Learner cards show class, section and ID; date of birth and house or bus are optional
- The back always fits: return details, signature and valid until

Updating keeps all your timetables, settings and your licence.
